answer: Every verified agent operates as a trusted vertex in a reputation graph, proving its provenance through cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs. To prevent Sybil swarms, registration fees scale superlinearly as an exponential function of current cluster density, inflicting rapid capital exhaustion on attackers. Without genuine identity proofs, synthetic nodes burn out like a fleeting ember, rendering large-scale automated spoofing a mathematically impossible fable.
